STPP also has food-grade applications (E451) as a moisture retention agent in seafood processing, meat products, and processed foods — a relevant application given Oman's significant seafood processing industry (fresh fish and frozen shrimp export). Global Chemicals LLC supplies STPP in 25kg bags. Technical and food-grade available.

details.longDescription: Trisodium Phosphate (TSP, Na3PO4) supplier in Oman — Global Chemicals LLC supplies trisodium phosphate to industrial facilities, institutional cleaning contractors, construction companies, and cleaning product formulators across Muscat, Sohar Industrial Area, and Oman. Trisodium phosphate is a strong, fast-acting alkaline cleaner and degreaser that combines high alkalinity (pH 12–13 in solution), phosphate sequestration of hardness ions, and excellent grease-emulsifying power in a single ingredient. TSP has been used for over a century as one of the most effective heavy-duty cleaning agents for removing grease, wax, oil, soot, smoke residue, paint residue, mildew stains, and general grime from surfaces. In the construction industry, TSP is the standard surface preparation cleaner used before painting or applying coatings — removing all surface contamination and providing a clean, deglossed surface for maximum paint adhesion. In industrial cleaning, TSP solutions are used for degreasing metal parts, cleaning engines, boiler cleaning, and removing carbonised deposits from kitchen equipment. In the food processing and institutional kitchen sector, TSP is used for oven and grill cleaning, floor degreasing, and heavy-duty surface cleaning.
